Package com.felipe.belo.mvp.auth

Class AuthController

java.lang.Object
com.felipe.belo.mvp.auth.AuthController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/auth") @Validated public class AuthController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling authentication-related operations, including login and token refresh functionalities. Exposes endpoints to authenticate users and generate new JWT tokens.
